headline: RapWire 24/7: Lil Baby, GloRilla, Takeoff, Nicki Minaj and Diddy
caption:
1) Lil Baby’s fifth studio album, FRESH, arrives at midnight Nov. 6 via Quality Control and Motown. The 17-track set keeps the guest list tight, with Future, Young Thug and Rylo Rodriguez together on “All My Partnas,” while Pharrell produced “Dead Fresh.” @lilbaby_1 @RapWire247

2) GloRilla and Sexyy Red are set to drop “Jiggly Bow Bow” Nov. 6 through CMG and Interscope. After a teaser drew criticism, Glo told detractors to skip the song and said she will do what she wants, making the pushback part of the rollout. @GloRilla @SexyyRed @RapWire247

3) The murder trial of Patrick Xavier Clark in Takeoff’s killing is no longer starting this month; the Harris County docket lists a jury setting for Apr. 15, 2027. The defense says scheduling conflicts and newly disclosed evidence need review, while Clark has pleaded not guilty and maintains his innocence. @1YoungTakeoff @RapWire247

4) Nicki Minaj’s former lawyers renewed a request for a $295,605 default award for unpaid fees tied to the “I Lied” copyright case. The underlying copyright dispute settled privately and was dismissed, but the fee claim is still headed to a Nov. 16 hearing. @NICKIMINAJ @RapWire247

5) Sher Tremonte says Sean Combs owes $581,893.75 for work in his defamation case against Courtney Burgess, Ariel Mitchell and Nexstar. The firm is seeking liens tied to the case files and any recovery, but Judge John P. Cronan still has to decide the amount and lien. @Diddy @RapWire247

@Rapwire247
